headline: Names a Jackson Heights, New York post office building after Jeanne and Jules Manford.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 7802 37th Avenue in Jackson Heights, New York, as the "Jeanne and Jules Manford Post Office Building." It is an honorary name change and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service, staffing, and hours are not affected by the law.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 29, 2016.
